standard_prerequisites.name: The projection formula and the structure of the pushforward of the structure sheaf of a line bundle
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Cohomology, label cohomology-lemma-projection-formula, invoked at proof line 5797
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the pushforward of the inverse of the pulled back invertible sheaf with the symmetric algebra twisted by the inverse, which is what makes the canonical trivialising section visible.

standard_prerequisites.name: The Gysin pullback of an effective Cartier divisor and additivity and flat pullback compatibility of capping with a first Chern class
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter chow.tex, labels lemma-relative-effective-cartier (proof lines 5807 and 5811), lemma-c1-cap-additive (proof line 5812) and lemma-flat-pullback-cap-c1 (proof line 5814)
standard_prerequisites.use: The first two formulae of that lemma give the identity o^* p^* = id and the expression of the pushforward of a class as minus the pullback of the cap with the Chern class, and the last two let the Chern class be moved through the flat pullback to derive the remaining identities.

standard_prerequisites.name: The computation of the composite of the pushforward with the pullback along the zero section
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter chow.tex, label lemma-gysin-back, invoked at proof line 5817
standard_prerequisites.use: Combined with the identity o^*p^*L = L, it gives that the composite of the pullback with the pushforward is minus the cap with the Chern class.

core_obligations: Identify the section: using the projection formula and the structure of the pushforward of the structure sheaf of the line bundle, the pushforward of the inverse of the pulled back invertible sheaf is the symmetric algebra twisted by that inverse, and the canonical trivialisation is the global section whose zero scheme is the image of the zero section (proof lines 5792-5802).

Dispose of the first four assertions: the regularity and the two induced maps follow as in the construction of the line bundle, and the identity of the composite of the pullback with the flat pullback is the first formula for an effective Cartier divisor (proof lines 5804-5807).

Derive the last two: the expression of the pushforward as minus the pullback of the cap with the Chern class follows from the second formula, additivity and compatibility of the cap with flat pullback, and the identity for the composite of the pullback with the pushforward follows from the earlier computation together with the triviality of the pullback of the invertible sheaf (proof lines 5809-5818).
proof_roadmap: Identify the section and its vanishing locus (proof lines 5792-5802).
Read off the regularity and the first identities (proof lines 5804-5807).
Derive the Chern class formulae (proof lines 5809-5818).
difficulty_reason: The lemma collects six formulae for the zero section of a line bundle: the zero section is the vanishing scheme of a regular global section of the inverse of the pulled back invertible sheaf, the induced pushforward and pullback, the identity of the composite with the flat pullback, and the two Chern class formulae for the pushforward and for the composite of the pullback with the pushforward (statement lines 5774-5790, tag 0F96). The first assertion needs the projection formula and the structure of the pushforward of the structure sheaf, while the remaining ones are assembled from the effective Cartier divisor formulae together with additivity and flat pullback compatibility of the Chern class. The identification of the section is the substance, so the claim is H2.
